metadata.title: SSPP Template - Email Campaign Platform
metadata.remarks: Architecture-driven SSPP template defining trust boundaries, consent and opt-out guarantees, data minimization, regulatory obligations, and auditable enforcement for an institutional Email Campaign Platform.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional baseline covering security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory overlays.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional outbound email campaign service used for authorized, high-volume communications to students, staff, faculty, and public stakeholders.

information-type.title: Email Address
information-type.description: Individual electronic mail address used for message delivery.

information-type.title: Consent Status
information-type.description: Certified indication of whether electronic communication is permitted under applicable law.

information-type.title: Opt-Out and Suppression State
information-type.description: Authoritative opt-out records including single-scope, multi-scope, and global suppression.

information-type.title: Campaign and Delivery History
information-type.description: Records of campaigns, recipients, delivery outcomes, engagement telemetry, and enforcement decisions.

props.name: primary-pattern
props.remarks: This system implements the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway solution pattern.

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: The system is approved only for planned, authorized outbound email campaigns and MUST NOT be used for ad-hoc, emergency, transactional, or personal messaging.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Campaigns may target students, staff, faculty, and public stakeholders only.

props.name: recipient-constraint
props.remarks: Recipients MUST be individual email addresses. Distribution lists, shared, role-based, or application mailboxes are prohibited.

props.name: content-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Email content MUST contain Level-1 (public) information only.

props.name: data-minimization
props.remarks: Only minimal recipient data (email address and consent/opt-out status) is retained; extended attributes are explicitly excluded.

props.name: consent-authority
props.remarks: Consent eligibility originates from authoritative external systems and is ingested as certified state under data exchange agreements.

props.name: opt-out-availability
props.remarks: Opt-out MUST support single-scope (unsubscribe link), multi-scope, and global opt-out.

props.name: opt-out-single-scope
props.remarks: Every email MUST include an unsubscribe mechanism enabling unauthenticated single-scope opt-out.

props.name: opt-out-preference-management
props.remarks: Users MUST have an authoritative view of all consented communications and be able to manage preferences holistically.

props.name: opt-out-enforcement
props.remarks: The Email Campaign Platform is the authoritative enforcement point for opt-out and suppression decisions.

props.name: opt-out-non-overridable
props.remarks: Opt-out decisions MUST NOT be overridden by campaign logic, targeting rules, or sender preference.

props.name: opt-out-auditability
props.remarks: All opt-out actions and enforcement decisions MUST be auditable.

props.name: branding-constraint
props.remarks: Sender identities and templates require institutional branding approval prior to use.

props.name: tenant-isolation
props.remarks: Campaign data, recipient information, audit logs, and sender identities are logically isolated per account.

props.name: audit-evidence-availability
props.remarks: Campaign, opt-out, and delivery records are retained per authoritative records and retention requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: Data flows are expressed through authority declarations, information types, enforcement assertions, and directional links rather than procedural sequencing.

components.title: Email Campaign Platform
components.description: Consumes certified consent state, enforces opt-out decisions, filters recipients at send time, and produces auditable campaign and delivery records.

links.text: Consumes certified consent and eligibility data via data exchange agreement.
Publishes opt-out and suppression state to prevent re-enrollment.
Forwards campaign execution and suppression events for centralized audit correlation.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is demonstrated through declared authority boundaries, invariant enforcement guarantees, and retained audit evidence rather than procedural descriptions.

roles.title: Account Owner
roles.description: Accountable for lifecycle, governance, access attestations, sender requests, decommissioning, and cost responsibility.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Campaign Author
roles.description: Creates draft campaign content and defines target audiences.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Content Developer per NIST NICE Framework; authors non-security campaign content.

roles.title: Campaign Manager
roles.description: Approves campaign intent and content for institutional compliance.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Risk Management Specialist per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Branding / Communications Approver
roles.description: Approves sender identities and branding assets.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework; executes approved release operations.

roles.title: Platform Administrator (ITS)
roles.description: Performs centralized platform configuration and enforcement; not delegated to tenants.
